name: My Knightmare In Shining Armor
source:
Makurayna, the Spider Queen of the Depths, has defeated all the knights sent by The Church and made snacks out of them. She has seen it all, she has heard all the speech.

... Then Castoriel, an elf who is merely trying his best, shows up.

He starts talking to her like she's a person, which is frankly inconvenient, and she would very much like him to stop.

Play as Makurayna and determine the fate of this naive Golden Hound!

[From [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/my-knightmare-in-shining-armor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深渊蜘蛛女王玛库瑞娜击败了教会派来的所有骑士，并用他们制作了零食。她已经看到了这一切，她也听到了所有的演讲。

……然后卡斯托里尔，一个只是尽力而为的精灵出现了。

他开始像她是一个人一样和她说话，坦率地说，这很不方便，她非常希望他停下来。

扮演Makurayna并决定这只天真的黄金猎犬的命运！

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/my-knightmare-in-shining-armor]itch.io[/url]]
